content.introduction: International stocks showed mixed performance today. The TecDAX in Germany rose by 102.44 points or 2.57%, the AEX in the Netherlands increased by 14.08 points or 1.28%, and the CAC 40 in France climbed by 61.88 points or 0.79%. In contrast, the SAX in Slovakia fell by 6.06 points or 1.86%. Reuters reported that tech stocks advanced in Europe and Nasdaq futures edged higher due to optimism over AI lab Anthropic's plans for a public debut. The Nikkei 225 in Japan declined by 647.26 points or 0.94%. The sources do not provide information on all international markets.
